objective: Teach release decisions for sealed samples using only the supplied rules.
rule_summary: Release implies seal_intact=true; seal_intact=true is necessary but not sufficient for release.
No supplied rule determines release when seal_intact=true or when the value is missing.
overlap_diagnosis: E1 and E2 share the same signature and undetermined decision, so E1 is retained and E2 consolidated.

coverage_signature.learner_decision: Decide whether to release or withhold the sample.

examples.rule_applied: The only-when rule makes an intact seal necessary, not sufficient, for release.
examples.learner_task: Determine whether the release decision follows from the supplied facts.
examples.meaningful_difference: Retains one supplied baseline while consolidating E2, which has the identical signature and decision.
examples.newly_covered_decision: Baseline uncertainty: an intact seal alone does not establish release.
